what_is_working: The partner-state banner is one shared component, not five: the 1320x130 band at y 60-190 is pixel-identical (mean absolute difference 0.00) across 01_pulse.png, 02_chat.png, 03_us.png, 04_moments.png and 05_settings.png.
The bottom nav is the same five chips in the same order (PULSE CHAT US MOMENTS SETTINGS) in every screenshot and every clip, with the current region raised.

08_state_propagating.mp4 does show the real mechanism: setting the mood on Pulse around frame 40 writes a quiet timeline line "noor is restless - Fri 4 Sep - 22:53" into Chat and updates the always-on banner on both regions - one write, two views, no second store visible.

05_settings.png's quiet-hours matrix (y 1680-2900) lists thirteen event types in one table spanning the messenger (something written, a picture, something to watch, their voice), feelings (a feeling), partner state (something their phone notices, something they say about themselves) and the Us modules (a date moving, the list moving, a day that matters) - one event vocabulary reaching one module.

12_search.png returns a to-do event, "text when home - kept" on graph-paper stock at y approximately 1500, inside a list of message results - a module event surfacing in a messenger view of the same log.

15_authored_feeling.mp4 ends with authored feelings ("pigeon", "tuesday soup") sitting in the Chat timeline on legal stock carrying ordinary delivery state ("waiting to send"), interleaved with a drawn feeling object and plain text notes in one list.
dusk_pulse.png reproduces 01_pulse.png's layout item-for-item under a warmer light rig, so the region reads as a view rendered under one light model rather than a bespoke painting.
verdict: Where the evidence shows the system, it genuinely is one system: an identical banner component across five regions, one nav, a mood set on Pulse arriving as a timeline line in Chat, a to-do turning up in message search, authored feelings sitting in the chat list with ordinary delivery state, and a single notification table that names thirteen event types from four different modules. That is real coherence and it is measurable. But three things stand between this and the floor. Moments, the region whose whole job is to be a second view onto the log, renders none of it - five bare "still fetching the picture." strings on wood and five blank duration scraps, with its own log recording fold.decoded 0 against 24 everywhere else. The pending state of a row is drawn as a hard-edged untextured rectangle (left-edge standard deviation 0.00 px against 19-34 px for its neighbours) and that second vocabulary leaks into three regions and four artifacts, never resolving at all in 08. And the two supports that would carry the rest of the claim are absent or substituted: there is no Android evidence of any kind, for a stated and credible reason that is nonetheless not evidence, and the one clip that demonstrates propagation runs on an eight-event fixture rather than the fourteen-thousand-event log every other artifact uses - while the per-capture reports for four of the five regions are a Chat-scoped probe copied verbatim, describing notes that appear in none of those screenshots.
